jobs.title: Head of Engineering, ML, Forma Generative AI
jobs.description:
Job Requisition ID #

26WD101528

Position Overview

Autodesk is transforming how the AEC industry designs and builds through integration of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) across its products, including AutoCAD, Revit, and Forma.

As Head of Engineering, ML for Forma Generative AI, you will lead the ML Engineering organization responsible for computational design and data representations, applied ML model development, and ML infrastructure and operations. You will lead through three engineering managers, setting the ML strategy for the team, defining the technical and organizational standards across the discipline, and shaping how teams build, deploy, and operate production ML systems.

You will partner closely with Architecture, Software Engineering, Research, Product, and other senior leaders to define technical direction, resolve cross-organizational trade-offs, and ensure the organization can move from promising ML research to reliable product capabilities at scale.

Report:
You will report to the Director, Forma Generative AI.

Location:
We support hybrid work, and you work near our Toronto, Canada office. This role requires the ability to travel to team meetings, offsites, and conferences in the USA, Canada, and Europe.

Responsibilities

Define and uphold ML engineering strategy, standards, and expectations across the organization, including how ML systems are designed, tested, reviewed, deployed, evaluated, and operated in production
Lead and develop the engineering managers responsible for Computational Design & Data Representations, Applied ML, and ML Infrastructure and Operations. Own the evolution of the ML engineering organization, including team structure, boundaries, hiring, succession, and organizational design
Partner with Architecture and peer engineering leaders to establish shared ML architectures, reusable components, and engineering practices that enable teams to move quickly without compromising quality or consistency
Partner with Research, Product, and Engineering leaders to balance long-term ML research and platform investments with iterative product delivery; align priorities, staffing, and capacity across the ML organization; surface constraints early and resolve cross-team trade-offs to keep critical work moving
Represent ML engineering in organizational planning, resourcing, escalations, and major technical decisions, serving as the discipline’s leadership voice across Forma Generative AI
Build a high-trust engineering culture that develops strong technical leaders, encourages knowledge sharing, and raises the quality of engineering judgement across the organization

Minimum Qualifications

BS or MS in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related field, or equivalent experience
8+ years of software/ML engineering experience, including 4+ years of engineering management experience and demonstrated experience managing engineering managers or leading multiple engineering teams
Track record building and operating production ML systems at scale across training, deployment, inference, monitoring, and evaluation
Experience establishing engineering standards and technical direction across multiple teams without centralizing every decision
Demonstrated success hiring, developing, and retaining engineering managers and senior technical leads, with strong communication and influence across senior stakeholders

Preferred Qualifications

Experience leading engineering organizations responsible for large-scale ML or foundation-model systems
Deep technical familiarity with modern ML engineering and production infrastructure, including ML frameworks (e.g. PyTorch), distributed training and inference, cloud infrastructure, observability, CI/CD, Infrastructure-as-Code, and production automation
Experience designing or leading development of foundation-model and agentic systems, including evaluation harnesses, tool-use/orchestration patterns, and other production scaffolding around models
Experience partnering with peer engineering, architecture, research, and product leaders in a matrixed organization
Experience in the AEC industry, Autodesk products, or another technically complex design/engineering domain
Experience applying rapidly evolving foundation-model and agentic-system technologies in production environments

The Ideal Candidate

You know the difference between managing a team and leading an organization; you develop strong managers, create clear ownership, and scale through others
You can establish a technical bar and make it stick through standards, coaching, and strong engineering judgement rather than personal gatekeeping
You build trust with senior peers across architecture, research, product, and engineering, and can navigate disagreement and ambiguity while keeping the organization moving
You communicate effectively across disciplines and levels, adapting your approach to build shared understanding with technical, product, research, and executive audiences

Learn More

About Autodesk

Welcome to Autodesk! Amazing things are created every day with our software – from the greenest buildings and cleanest cars to the smartest factories and biggest hit movies. We help innovators turn their ideas into reality, transforming not only how things are made, but what can be made.

We take great pride in our culture here at Autodesk – it’s at the core of everything we do. Our culture guides the way we work and treat each other, informs how we connect with customers and partners, and defines how we show up in the world.

When you’re an Autodesker, you can do meaningful work that helps build a better world designed and made for all. Ready to shape the world and your future? Join us!

Salary transparency

Salary is one part of Autodesk’s competitive compensation package. For Canada based roles, we expect a starting base salary between $156,000 and $228,800. Offers are based on the candidate’s experience and geographic location, and may exceed this range. In addition to base salaries, our compensation package may include annual cash bonuses, commissions for sales roles, stock grants, and a comprehensive benefits package.

Belonging

We take pride in cultivating a culture of belonging where everyone can thrive. Learn more here: https://www.autodesk.com/company/global-belonging

In-Person Onboarding and Identity Verification

This role may require in-person onboarding and/or in-person ID verification.

jobs.title: Head of Digital
jobs.description:
Head of Digital

This is a full-time, in-office position based at INK Entertainment's Head Office in the heart of Yorkville. We believe our best ideas come from collaboration, creativity, and being together, which is why this role works primarily from our Toronto headquarters, partnering closely with teams across our restaurants, nightlife venues, live events, and entertainment brands.

Build the Future of Hospitality, Entertainment & Live Experiences.

At INK Entertainment
, we don't just open restaurants or produce events—we create destinations, experiences, and brands that people remember.

From award-winning restaurants and nightlife venues to concerts, festivals, and cultural experiences, INK is redefining hospitality and entertainment across North America. Its restaurant portfolio includes Amal (Toronto, Miami & Fort Lauderdale), Byblos (Toronto & Miami), Daphne, Figo, Level 6 (Miami), Beso by Patria, Sofia Yorkville, Sofia Design District (Miami), Primadonna, Vinny, Honey Chinese, Melani, STORYS Building, Portland Room and its premium QSR concept Little Baba. INK also operates trendsetting nightlife destinations, including REBEL, Cabana, and DPRTMNT. The company represents Taglialatella Galleries in Toronto, New York, and Paris, and produces Canada’s largest electronic music festival, VELD, now entering its 14th consecutive year.

We're looking for a visionary Head of Digital
to lead the next evolution of our digital ecosystem and transform how millions of guests discover, engage with, and experience our brands. If you're equally passionate about technology, creativity, customer experience, data, and culture, this is an opportunity to shape one of Canada's most dynamic hospitality and entertainment companies.

As Head of Digital, you'll lead the digital strategy across INK's portfolio of restaurants, nightlife venues, concerts, festivals, hospitality brands, and corporate initiatives.
You'll own the digital roadmap—from websites and CRM to paid media, SEO, marketing technology, AI, analytics, and digital customer experiences. You'll partner with leaders across Marketing, Operations, Creative, Brand Partnerships, PR, Events, and Technology to drive measurable business growth while building exceptional digital experiences.
You'll also lead and mentor our digital team, including Social Media, ensuring every digital touchpoint reflects the creativity and innovation that defines INK.

What You'll Own:

Digital Strategy

Define and execute INK's enterprise digital strategy across hospitality, entertainment, music, and live events.
Identify emerging technologies and consumer trends that create competitive advantage.
Lead digital transformation initiatives that improve customer experience and business performance.
Build the roadmap for future digital growth.

Customer Growth

Grow reservations, ticket sales, memberships, loyalty, gift card sales, and online revenue.
Develop CRM, email, SMS, and lifecycle marketing strategies that increase customer acquisition, retention, and lifetime value.
Optimize every step of the digital customer journey.

Digital Marketing

Lead paid media strategy across Google, Meta, TikTok, YouTube, Snapchat, Reddit, Spotify, and emerging platforms.
Oversee SEO, digital advertising, audience acquisition, conversion optimization, and performance marketing.
Manage agency relationships and media investments to maximize ROI.

Digital Experiences

Oversee the strategy and evolution of INK's websites, ticketing experiences, reservation platforms, and digital products.
Ensure every digital experience is intuitive, accessible, mobile-first, and conversion-focused.
Champion innovation using AI, automation, personalization, and emerging technology.

Music, Live Events & Brand Partnerships

Develop digital marketing strategies that drive awareness and ticket sales for concerts, festivals, nightlife programming, and live experiences.
Partner with artists, promoters, venues, agencies, and brand partners to amplify campaigns across digital channels.
Support sponsorship activations with measurable digital strategies that create value for partners and unforgettable experiences for guests.

Analytics & Innovation

Turn data into action through reporting, attribution, experimentation, and optimization.
Build executive dashboards and performance insights that influence business decisions.
Continuously test, learn, and improve.

Who You Are:

You're a strategic digital leader who thrives in fast-paced, creative environments. You know how to balance brand storytelling with performance marketing, and you're as comfortable discussing customer acquisition costs as you are envisioning the next big digital experience.
You bring curiosity, commercial thinking, and a passion for innovation—and you're excited to help shape what's next.

What You'll Bring:

8+ years of progressive digital marketing experience, including leadership experience.
Experience in hospitality, entertainment, live events, music, lifestyle, retail, or consumer brands.
Expertise across paid media, SEO, CRM, marketing automation, analytics, websites, and digital strategy.
Experience leading multi-brand digital ecosystems.
Strong understanding of audience growth, customer acquisition, digital commerce, and lifecycle marketing.
Experience managing agencies, budgets, and cross-functional teams.
Knowledge of ticketing platforms, event marketing, sponsorship activations, or entertainment marketing is a strong asset.
Familiarity with Google Analytics 4, Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, TikTok Ads, CRM platforms (including Tradable Bits), CMS platforms, AI marketing tools, and marketing technology ecosystems.

Why INK?

This isn't a traditional hospitality marketing role.
You'll help shape some of Canada's most recognized restaurants, nightlife venues, music experiences, festivals, and entertainment brands while working alongside some of the industry's most creative minds.
You'll have the freedom to build, innovate, challenge convention, and make a measurable impact on a growing portfolio of iconic brands.
If you're ready to redefine what digital looks like in hospitality and entertainment, we'd love to meet you.

The salary range for this role is $100,000 to $120,000 CAD per year, plus benefits.
The final offer will be based on a variety of factors, including relevant experience, skills, education, and market considerations.

Diversity, Equity & Inclusion

At INK Entertainment
, we believe that great experiences are created by diverse teams and unique perspectives. We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where every employee feels welcomed, respected, empowered, and supported to do their best work.
We celebrate diversity in all its forms and encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds, identities, experiences, and abilities.
We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to providing an accessible and inclusive recruitment process in accordance with the Ontario Human Rights Code and the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act (AODA). If you require accommodation at any stage of the hiring process, please let us know and we will work with you to meet your needs.

We take great pride in our culture here at Autodesk – it’s at the core of everything we do. Our culture guides the way we work and treat each other, informs how we connect with customers and partners, and defines how we show up in the world.

When you’re an Autodesker, you can do meaningful work that helps build a better world designed and made for all. Ready to shape the world and your future? Join us!

Salary transparency

Salary is one part of Autodesk’s competitive compensation package. For Canada based roles, we expect a starting base salary between $156,000 and $228,800. Offers are based on the candidate’s experience and geographic location, and may exceed this range. In addition to base salaries, our compensation package may include annual cash bonuses, commissions for sales roles, stock grants, and a comprehensive benefits package.
